text:
elaine: FYI BrightPath (retail search) opened a request to onboard a custom intent reranker (7B). They want private deployment + HSM for keys and PHI filtering disabled for some traffic. Renewal is up in 10 weeks — we should treat this as high-touch.

raj: thanks, noted. do we have their dataset yet? and is 7B the final model choice or are they evaluating 3/7/13 options?

marta: they sent a small sample corpus last week (csv with user queries + click labels). asked for latency target <= 120ms p95. also flagged a compliance need: certain customer PII must be redacted before logging.

elaine: ok — primary asks: private deploy, KMS/HSM integration, redaction pipeline, eval plan for relevance + hallucination checks, SLA discussion. we should map to Dedicated vs Private onprem.

sam: quick infra note — a private VPC deploy of 7B with HSM is possible but needs capacity reservation. can we get a headcount estimate for token throughput and concurrency?

elaine: customer expects ~200 qps peak, mostly short queries. they want canary rollout and rollback on mismatch.

raj: for evals I suggest: (1) offline relevance A/B vs their current reranker, (2) safety/regression suite with 500 prompts including PII cases, (3) cost/latency bench. I can own run of (3) if they share dataset and access.

marta: i'll own the safety/regression tests. please include these checks: redaction correctness, false positives on PHI filters, and end-to-end telemetry to confirm no PHI in logs.

sam: infra quirk: HSM-backed key rotation requires lead time with our partner. estimate 2–3 weeks after contract. flagging on renewal timeline.

elaine: noted. this is a renewal risk if they can't get HSM quick. let's propose temporary TLS-only and roadmap to HSM. @raj @marta can you draft an eval checklist for the kickoff tomorrow?

raj: drafting now. sending a short config snippet they can copy into their infra: 

```
model: brightpath-custom-7b
deployment: private-vpc
kms: aws-hsm (pending-contract)
canary: true
log_redaction: true
p95_target_ms: 120
```

marta: also adding a prompt set to exercise redaction edge cases — will upload to the shared folder and tag the customer.

deploy-bot: Deployment slot check: private-vpc capacity for 7B currently has 1 available slot in us-west-2. Reservation recommended.

elaine: great — next steps: (1) raj: send eval checklist + perf script to BrightPath, (2) marta: upload redaction prompt set and run safety baseline, (3) sam: open capacity reservation ticket and estimate cost delta, (4) CS: schedule enablement + handoff call with engineering and security tomorrow. I'll capture feedback and account health notes in the renewal tracker.

raj: will do. tagging the thread with the playbook link and a quick prompt template for their engineers: https://redwood.company/playbooks/onboard-reranker

marta: thanks — i'll also include a short survey after enablement to capture their integration pain points for postmortem/renewal play.

sam: opened ticket #INC-7192 for capacity reservation and HSM timeline.

elaine: perfect. if anything blocks before the call ping me. :thumbsup:
